name: Does low funding pick next week's winners

history.reason: KILL, rejected with Luke's say-so (2026-11-16). 234 Sunday closes 2020-09 to 2025-10, a median of 19 liquid coins a week: the signal (minus 7-day funding) had a slope of -0.26% a week per SD with past week and size controlled, P(> 0) 9% (90% needed): low funding did worse, the opposite of the idea. Its top fifth trailed the average coin by 0.16% a week; as money it lost 87% after costs (drawdown -98%), and the crowded fifth lost 53%. A 'funding momentum' version would be a new note with this result disclosed.
